method: Every credit kind in the WP5 census is traced to the battery code path that awarded it. Completeness is by the enumeration's own rule: every pass-awarding return in the frozen battery (6 literal `return True` branches and 2 computed pass returns) lies inside exactly one enumerated path's line range; every kind in the census is awarded by exactly one path; every kind in the audit generator's DEFAULT_CREDITS is awarded by exactly one pass-by-default path.

paths.note: The expectation checks run over the role's avg_position and starter/ending flags and the verdict is computed from them. A real measurement — but the test never uses the proposed reading, so it supports distribution and functional role only (WP5 code fact 'positional_reading_blind').
PASS BY DEFAULT: the role has no expectation entry (UNKNOWN role or unlisted role), so there is nothing to check against and the branch returns a pass.
PASS BY DEFAULT: the normalized reading is shorter than 2 characters, so the dictionary check does not run and the branch returns a pass.

The dictionary scan ran (counts at lines 141-142) and found at least one entry equal to the normalized reading. Lexical plausibility, per the WP5 code fact: it shows a word of this shape exists, not that this sign stood for that word.
The dictionary scan ran (counts at lines 141-142) and found 2 or more entries sharing the first 3 normalized characters with the reading (or the reverse). Weak lexical plausibility.
PASS BY DEFAULT: the reading's first character is absent from the language model, so no comparison is possible and the branch returns a pass.
PASS BY DEFAULT: none of the sign's top following signs has a HIGH or MEDIUM anchor reading, so no neighbour could be checked and the branch returns a pass.

The neighbour comparison ran and the match ratio met the 0.4 threshold. A real comparison as recorded — but the comparison set is backend-dependent (top-5 continuations with torch, all continuations without; lines 161-170), so the pass is not the same test across backends (WP5 code fact 'bigram_backend_divergence').
Not a credit path: the promotion rule. A sign is promoted when any 2 of the 3 tests pass, so default credits counted toward promotion exactly like measured passes (WP5 code fact 'promotion_rule').

observed_non_credit_default.observation: test_positional line 110 defaults a missing avg_position to 0.5 before the expectation checks run. This is input defaulting inside path P1, not a separate verdict path: the verdict is still computed by the expectation checks, and no census kind corresponds to it. Named here so battery v2's authors see it; it is not counted among the four pass-by-default paths.

reconciliation.register_text: GR-088-03 (the Spec 088 gap register): the promoting battery 'carried four pass-by-default paths and promoted 30 of 30 tested'.
reconciliation.verdict: AGREES. The register's four is a count of code paths; the census's two default-credit kinds are the two of the four paths that fired in the recorded run (default_credit_too_short: 9 credits via P3; default_credit_missing_model_character: 5 credits via P6). The other two paths (P2 no-expectation, P7 no-anchor-neighbours) fired zero times in the recorded run, so their kinds appear in the audit classifier's DEFAULT_CREDITS vocabulary but not in pass_credits_by_kind. Paths and credit kinds are different units (grounding record gap 2); there is no contradiction and no register amendment is owed.
